noticias.resumo:
NEW YORK, Oct 9 (Reuters) - US companies are likely to deliver another earnings surge for the third quarter, and like the rally in the stock market, AI-related players are fueling most ​of those gains. 

While investors are enthusiastic about the hyper earnings growth fueled by AI companies, many are also worried about ‌how long the trend can continue, and what will happen to share prices when it ends.

noticias.titulo: Nasdaq rises after OpenAI revenue report rattles AI stocks
noticias.resumo: The rebound follows a rough Thursday for tech stocks after CNBC confirmed that OpenAI told investors it had $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September.  That figure fell short of the $68 billion widely reported the previous month, though, according to CNBC, a person familiar with the matter said the earlier figure included gross revenue from partners.  Thursday's session left the Nasdaq down over 1%, a decline not seen on a single day since mid-August, according to CNBC.
